source.stem: What helps oxygen to be absorbed rapidly into the blood in the lungs?

options.text: Air breathed in has less oxygen than air breathed out.
Alveoli have thick walls and a large surface area.
Alveoli have thin walls and a large surface area.
The concentration of oxygen in the blood is higher than in the alveoli.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Antibiotics are suitable for every infection.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Careless antibiotic use makes bacteria easier to kill, so the same antibiotic becomes more effective.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: A fever alone means an antibiotic is needed.

intelligence.enrichment: Antibiotics kill bacteria that cause disease, but indiscriminate use can lead to antibiotic-resistant bacteria and reduce antibiotic effectiveness. When antibiotics are used carelessly, resistant bacteria can develop and spread, so the same antibiotics protect people less effectively against bacterial infections. The learner correctly applies this rule: Antibiotics kill bacteria that cause disease, but indiscriminate use can lead to antibiotic-resistant bacteria and reduce antibiotic effectiveness. Antibiotics are strong medicines for any fever or sore throat, and taking them often keeps them powerful.
